1.title: Exam Orientation and How to Study
1.text: Welcome to Module zero: Exam Orientation and How to Study. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do six things. The exam at a glance. The four domains. What the exam does not test. How to answer every question. A four-week study plan. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Scope: Exam overview, domain map and answer technique (all domains). Exam format: fifty scored questions, multiple choice and multiple response; a score of seven hundred twenty on a scale of one hundred to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official A W S Developer Associate (D V A-C three) exam guide.

1.title: The exam at a glance
1.text: The exam at a glance. Scored questions. fifty. Unscored questions. fifteen, not marked on the exam, so treat every question as scored. Response types. Multiple choice (one correct, three distractors) and multiple response (two or more correct out of five or more; all must be selected). Passing score. seven hundred twenty on a scale of one hundred to one thousand. Scoring model. Compensatory: you pass the exam as a whole, not each domain. Guessing. No penalty; unanswered questions count as wrong. Target candidate. One or more years developing and maintaining applications on A W S.

1.title: The exam at a glance, continued
1.text: The exam at a glance. The older exam is D V A-C two (last day November thirty, two thousand twenty-six). D V A-C three is used from December one, two thousand twenty-six. It adds A I-assisted development, managed A I services and securing A I services. Exam tip: On a multiple response question the stem says how many to choose (for example "Choose two"). You get credit only if you select all the correct options, so read the number first.

1.title: The four domains
1.text: The four domains. The figure shows this: Domain map: four domains, twelve tasks, and the modules that cover them.

1.title: The four domains, continued
1.text: The four domains. one. Development with A W S Services. Weight: thirty percent. Tasks: Code for hosted applications; Lambda; data stores. two. Security. Weight: twenty-six percent. Tasks: Authentication and authorization; encryption and sensitive data; securing A I services. three. Testing and Deployment. Weight: twenty-two percent. Tasks: Artifacts; testing; C I or C D deployment. four. Troubleshooting and Optimization. Weight: twenty-two percent. Tasks: Root cause analysis; logging and observability; optimization. Exam tip: Domain one plus Domain two is fifty-six percent. Lambda, Dynamo D B, S Q S, S N S, A P I Gateway, I A M, K M S and Cognito appear again and again.

1.title: What the exam does not test
1.text: What the exam does not test. The guide lists job tasks that are out of scope: designing architectures, designing C I or C D pipelines, administering I A M users and groups, administering servers, selecting foundation models, prompt engineering and R A G design, A I governance, E T L design and network design. Services such as Amazon Polly, Rekognition, Sage Maker A I and Strands Agents are out of scope.

1.title: How to answer every question
1.text: How to answer every question. Read the last line (what is asked, how many answers). Underline the constraint: cheapest, least operational overhead, most secure, lowest latency, no code change. Eliminate options that break the constraint or use an out-of-scope idea. Choose the option that uses the managed A W S feature designed for the job. Never leave a blank. Developer-exam habits: prefer I A M roles to access keys, Secrets Manager or Parameter Store to hard-coded secrets, S Q S or S N S or Event Bridge to tight coupling, and retry with backoff to immediate retry loops.

1.title: A four-week study plan
1.text: A four-week study plan. one. Modules: one to four. Goal: Integration, resilience, S D Ks, A I-assisted development. two. Modules: five to seven. Goal: Lambda, Dynamo D B, data stores and caching. three. Modules: eight to ten and eleven to thirteen. Goal: Security, artifacts, testing, C I or C D. four. Modules: fourteen to sixteen. Goal: Troubleshooting, optimization, mixed practice.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. What is the minimum passing score on the D V A-C three exam? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: seven hundred twenty. The minimum passing score is seven hundred twenty on a scale of one hundred to one thousand.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A candidate does not know an answer. What should the candidate do? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Answer it, because there is no penalty for guessing. Unanswered questions are scored as incorrect and there is no guessing penalty.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. What is required to earn credit on a multiple response question? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Select all the correct options. All correct responses must be selected to receive credit.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Which two domains together carry fifty-six percent of the scored content? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Development with A W S Services and Security. Development with A W S Services is thirty percent and Security is twenty-six percent.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. How many questions are scored? Answer: fifty (plus fifteen unscored questions that are not identified). Question two. What does "compensatory" scoring mean? Answer: You must pass the exam as a whole, not each domain. Question three. Name the four domains. Answer: Development with A W S Services; Security; Testing and Deployment; Troubleshooting and Optimization.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Which exam does D V A-C three replace, and from when? Answer: D V A-C two, from December one, two thousand twenty-six. Question five. What is new in D V A-C three? Answer: A I-assisted development, managed A I services and securing A I services. Question six. Name one job task that is out of scope. Answer: For example designing architectures, administering I A M users, or selecting foundation models.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Format: fifty scored plus fifteen unscored; multiple choice and multiple response; seven hundred twenty to pass. Domains: thirty or twenty-six or twenty-two or twenty-two percent. New in C three: A I-assisted development, managed A I services, A I security. Method: read the last line, find the constraint, eliminate, pick the managed feature. If this course is helping you, please subscribe to the channel and hit the bell icon, so you get a notification when the next video is out. In the next module, we continue the course.
